title: Mac meets MSFS 2024 (And it's not what you expect)
description:
Can you play MSFS 2024 on Mac? Yes! In this video, we dive into how to run Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 on MacOS using Xbox Cloud Gaming. While MSFS 2024 is a technical marvel, many Apple Silicon and Intel Mac users feel left out. Today, we bypass the hardware limits to get you airborne.

We test the MSFS 2024 Mac gameplay over London to check visual quality, streaming latency, and the honest limitations of cloud gaming. Whether you have an M1, M2, M3, or M4 Mac, this guide covers the Xbox Game Pass Ultimate setup, controller support, and the 50Mbps internet requirement you need to fly.

Is Xbox Cloud Gaming the best way to play Flight Simulator on Mac? We look at the 1080p resolution cap and why certain peripherals like joysticks and yokes might not work.

In this video:

- How to access Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 on Mac
- Xbox Cloud Gaming performance test (London City)
- Mac hardware requirements (Intel vs Apple Silicon M-series)
- The "Catch": Resolution limits and controller issues
